backgrounds.name: bg_siberian_garage
backgrounds.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete background layer for a 2D armwrestling game, landscape 16:9, ideally 1280x720. Draw ONE polished full-bleed image, no collage. Style: hand-painted comic / anime game environment, crisp dark ink outlines, believable perspective, cel-shaded objects, textured surfaces, natural cinematic light, matching an illustrated gym game. Camera: fixed eye-level view from the player's side of the armwrestling position. The fighter and foreground table will be added by the game: DO NOT draw any people, limbs, armwrestling tables, UI, captions, watermark or brand logos. Keep the central 45 percent visually calm with unobstructed space and low contrast so the opponent's face at center upper third and arms across the middle stay readable; place identifying scenery on both far sides and in upper back wall. The lower third is open floor. Primary request: unique background for Vitaly Laletin. Biographical inspiration: Russian armwrestler from Siberia with a past career driving trucks. Scene: a rugged heated Siberian truck garage repurposed as a strength-training space. At far left a large open garage door shows part of a parked heavy truck cab outside, snowbanks and snow-dusted pine trees at blue hour. The truck is secondary, not central. At far right a metal rack holds thick grip handles, weight plates and a lat pulley machine. Exposed steel roof beams, practical warm workshop lights, a small shelf of trophies at the side. Central back wall is worn dark teal painted concrete. Palette: icy blue outside, muted teal and steel indoors, amber lights. No text or flags required. Artistic fictional setting inspired by his background, not a literal reconstruction.
